stem:
Maya notes that a fish has gills and a streamlined body.

Are those features adaptations for survival in water?

options.text: No. An adaptation can only be a colour change.
Yes. Those features help the fish live and move in water.
Yes. Any noted body feature of the fish counts as an adaptation for water.
No. Body parts cannot be adaptations.

teacher.key_rationale: Gills and a streamlined body help survival and movement in water, so they are adaptations.
